landing.announcement: The public registry of AI dev skills — free for devs, paid for teams
landing.h1_top: The registry of AI skills for devs
landing.h1_bottom: and the team hub for companies that want control
landing.lede: Free for devs. Forever. Paid for teams that need governance, audit and private skills.
landing.track_free_body: 500+ curated skills, one-command CLI install, community reviews. Free, no account needed to browse.
landing.track_teams_body: Your devs love AI skills. Your CTO wants to know what's running. Forgekit Teams reconciles both — SSO, audit log, allowlist, private skills.
landing.track_enterprise_body: For sensitive sectors — banking, health, defense: Confidential Compute execution, on-prem mirror, advanced SCIM, SOC 2 Type II, signed DPA.

pricing.title: Free for devs.
pricing.lede: The registry stays free. Forever. Teams pay for governance, not for access.
pricing.plan_free_pitch: For devs who want to install, vote, contribute.
pricing.plan_teams_pitch: For companies that want control without slowing their devs.
pricing.plan_ent_pitch: For regulated organizations: confidential compute, on-prem, SOC 2.
pricing.faq_a1: Yes. Access, install and public skill publishing will remain free. It's the core of the product, not the business model.
pricing.faq_a2: Minimum 5 seats, monthly or annual (−15% yearly). You only pay activated seats. EU MoR billing, VAT handled.
pricing.faq_q3: Are my internal skills really private?
pricing.faq_a3: Yes. The Teams workspace is isolated: internal skills are not indexed, never exposed, never used to train anything.
pricing.faq_q4: Can I try Teams for free?
pricing.faq_a4: Yes — 14-day trial on all seats, no card. If you don't convert, the workspace switches to read-only.
pricing.faq_q5: Can I migrate between Enterprise and Teams?
pricing.faq_a5: Yes, both ways. No penalty, pro-rata applied on the current period.

teams.title: Your devs love AI skills.
teams.title_italic: Your CTO wants to know what's running.
teams.lede: Forgekit Teams reconciles both: private workspace, signed audit log, per-project allowlist, internal non-public skills. Without slowing anyone down.
teams.features_title: Everything a CTO asks for, without killing velocity.
teams.feature_sso_body: Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, Okta, OneLogin. Auto-provisioning, instant deprovisioning when a dev leaves.
teams.feature_audit_body: Every install, update, execution: tracked, timestamped, cryptographically signed. CSV export or SIEM stream (Splunk, Datadog).
teams.feature_allowlist_body: Define which skills are allowed per repo, branch or environment. Block out-of-scope executions client-side via the CLI.
teams.feature_private_body: Publish your proprietary prompts and skills to a private registry. Never indexed, never exposed, never used to train anything.
teams.feature_cross_body: One skill installed everywhere: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Gemini CLI. Auto-sync between machines via your workspace.
teams.feature_support_body: Email 24 h (Teams), 4 h business hours (Enterprise). Dedicated CSM above 50 seats. No chatbot, no tier 1.
teams.testimonial_quote: First AI tool I could roll out without waking security at 10 pm. Signed audit log, allowlist, end of shadow IT.
